why: owner 25 Nov: Interface actions failed because of this AddOn (534)

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.1.1-beta for WoW Forever 1.60.1.71091

Fixes
- Combat: the addon no longer rewrites ANY line of the game's quest list / tracker or of the Questie tracker while you are in combat (those rows hold protected buttons, the game counted every attempt as 'Interface actions failed because of this AddOn'). The lines are translated right after the combat ends. The Questie tooltip rewrite is also off in combat.
- New: the addon now records which protected call the game blocked (first one per function, in the Status page error list and once in chat) so a remaining case can be named exactly.
